name: @wazoo/sparql-engine
description: Zero-dependency SPARQL 1.1 & 1.2 query and update engine over RDF/JS Quad Stores.

tasks.bench:size: deno run --allow-read bench/measure-libs.ts > bench/size-data.json && deno run --allow-read --allow-write bench/treemap.ts && deno fmt docs/assets/chart-*.svg docs/assets/treemap-*.svg
tasks.bench:size:closures: deno run --allow-read --allow-write bench/measure-closures.ts && deno run --allow-read --allow-write bench/treemap.ts && deno fmt docs/assets/chart-*.svg docs/assets/treemap-*.svg
tasks.bench:memory: deno run --allow-all bench/collect-memory.ts && deno run --allow-read --allow-write bench/treemap.ts && deno fmt docs/assets/chart-*.svg docs/assets/treemap-*.svg
tasks.bench:latency: deno bench --allow-all --json bench/engine_bench.ts > bench/latency-data.json && deno run --allow-read --allow-write bench/latency-chart.ts && deno fmt docs/assets/chart-latency.svg
tasks.bench:latency:check: BENCH_INVENTORY=1 deno bench --allow-all --json bench/engine_bench.ts | deno run --allow-read bench/latency-check.ts

ci.description: Formats, lints, checks, and tests the code
